notes.title: Small update
notes.notes: Minor bug fixes and minor performance improvements

notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

In today's update we bring you:

- The "SKELETON KING" Halloween themed boss, and his army of skeletons.
- 2x XP during this spooky period, which will last for 3 weeks

We have also made several improvements and fixes including:
- Better baked lighting on all maps
- Achievements bug fixed so they can now be unlocked as usual

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.8 - Laser Fences & more!
notes.notes:
Today we bring you laser fences!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/c47acffefd61d1e350c81662e29b2fd27eb9e95c.png

These fences will obliterate anything that tries to pass through and turn them to dust, they are expensive though and you can only build 20, so use them wisely!

We've also increased the performance of the game slightly in this update.

We are aware of several annoying bugs, one of which being that when you shoot zombies in some cases the bullets do 0 damage. We are working on fixing this right now and the fix will be included in the next update.

Thank you!

notes.title: Public Test beta & Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

From now on we will introduce new updates a little earlier on a beta branch. For those of you who wish to access the new content faster all you need to do is:

- Right click the game in your library and select properties
- Navigate to the beta tab
- Select the public-test branch 

This will set your game to the latest available version. To go back to the default simply opt out of all betas. Note that multiplayer only works for players on the same game version.

New changes available on public-test:

- Bug with turret reloading fixed
- Engineer drone turret lasers range reduced
- Large icon bug for players who join in progress fixed
- Witch enemy had a bug where the camera shake did not work, fixed
- Fixed a bug if the player died whilst on a gun turret they would re-spawn and not be able to move
- Fixed a bug where the engineer drone was not visible to everyone in some circumstances
- Performance increases on client side players

Thank you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/629457fe1f2a3bc8ce40c1db0870516069857780.jpg

- 'Just in case' bug fixed

notes.title: Skill tree bug fixes
notes.notes:
We've hotfixed an issue with the skill tree:

- On unlocking an ability such as medic station, previously players had to restart the game in order to be able to build it in-game. This is now fixed.
- Minor performance Improvements to the game

LET US KNOW WHAT YOU WOULD LIKE TO SEE NEXT IN THE COMMENTS :)

- Terror Dog team

notes.title: 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
We are so happy to announce the release of 1.0 version of the game. There is a lot of updates which include:

- Skill tree & Level up system
- 4 new playable classes: Medic, Heavy, Specialist & Engineer
- Earn xp at the end of games to power up your characters
- Unlock powerful max abilities such as the gun drone (Engineer), Invulnerability (Medic), Berserk mode (Heavy) & Critical damage (Specialist)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/91d212b67b898ca8e5af478ced67705943a4ae11.png

ACHIEVEMENTS UNLOCKED
- 12 unlock-able achievements

HOST WITH PRIVATE, NAMED SERVERS
- Players hosting games can now name & set a password on them if preferred

- Disable slow-mo option has been implemented for solo players to toggle if they wish
- Sentries now target mini soupex & hell hounds more effectively

Thank you all once again for your support. Now go unlock some achievements! :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/4ae6affa682b51c97e110cc2d669572bd26c8222.gif

notes.title: MAJOR BUG FIXES
notes.notes:
We've been able to identify and resolve some of the major problems the game has had for some time. Full list of bugs fixed in this patch below:

Bugs Fixed

- Black screen on game launch issue is FIXED
- Black screen issue on loading into map is FIXED
- Grabbing zombie not letting go of player FIXED
- Player icons will now show for everyone when playing in multiplayer FIXED
- Hell hounds getting stuck in some corners of shops (Mall) FIXED
- Cash rounding issue FIXED
- Night-vision turns off whilst using some weapons FIXED
- When a player dies they keep shooting FIXED
- When you buy from the shop in a host's game the button will not automatically update FIXED
- When players use the elevator in the Mall they float up/down when changing floors FIXED
- Some players could access the skill tree early FIXED
- The host player's ready status would not update when changing map/difficulty FIXED

New Features
- The game will remember what difficulty you were playing on previously
- The number of players online will be shown at all times on the main menu & server browser

New Language Support
- Traditional Chinese
- Portuguese & Portuguese BR
- Spanish LA & C
- Italian
- Polish
- Turkish

Keep Slay'n!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/fd8c35d030dfd1327e1392ec92610846caf95f41.gif

notes.title: Patch notes 0.9.5
notes.notes:
In this weeks patch:

- Flamethrower damage buff

- Score tab now updates correctly, showing number of kills per player etc.

FYI
Bridge map almost ready to release

notes.title: Patch notes 0.9.4
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug causing an error when a player left during multiplayer
- Permissions now work on the host menu where you can change the game between public & private
- Game will now start automatically (after a short countdown) once all players ready up in the lobby
- You will now be able to cycle between all the players whilst spectating by pressing the mouse 1 button

- Player's mini-map icons are now colour-coded to their name/score
- Fixed a bug where zombies would not scan on the mini-map if they are too far out of range

notes.title: Patch notes 0.9.1
notes.notes:
A few more fixes in the latest version:

- Fixed a crashing issue that had previously affected a number of players
- Fixed a bug where bosses would stand still
- Fixed an issue where some garden fences wouldn't spawn in on the city map
- Added an invite players option in the lobby
- The '+' invite buttons now work in the lobby
- Added a permissions option to the host game screen to toggle between public and private games

notes.title: Patch notes 0.9.0
notes.notes:
The recent release of the multiplayer beta came with it a bunch of issues that a lot of you have been helping identify on our discord server, so thanks for that!

Here's what we've added in this update:

- In-game chat. Simply press 'T' or 'Y' to open the chat interface.
- Fixed a bug where boss zombies could appear under the map.
- Player has joined/left the lobby message in chat box
- Fixed the double stacked buildings bug
- Fixed a bug where the screaming zombie's shaking effect would also affect other players 
- Fixed a repair bug where sometimes a building would appear to need fixed when it was full health
- Kill count on the score tab is now fixed and will record each player's performance
- Player names have been added next to their health bar 
- Increased zombie health for each additional player in your party
- Fixed a bug where the garden fences would not spawn in
- Fixed a bug where the host's character model would apply for everyone
- Implemented steam invites
- Added an invitation UI pop-up where you can notify/get notified to join a game
- Some minor performance increases
- Other various fixes

We'll continue improving the performance of the game during multiplayer sessions & push out updates at any given opportunity.

notes.title: Patch notes 0.8.0
notes.notes:
This week we have been progressing with multiplayer and started design on an additional map.

We have had several issues pop-up on our radar we have fixed in the meantime:

- Electric grids are now dragable when placing
- Laser clipping bug fixed.
- Barbed wire sound bug fixed. 
- Weapon reload issue fixed where shotguns/grenade launcher weapons were causing a non-reload related issue

notes.title: Patch notes 0.7.5
notes.notes:
This week, we have added some satisfying destruction feedback to the game.

Your defences will now crumble to pieces once destroyed, instead of just disappear:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/86aaf6821371b4b7253532aad1c0baacf7859751.gif

Sentries are now more efficient, and will attack the next closest enemy, making them much more powerful than before.

Other than that we've balanced the electric grid, by decreasing the amount of time it will stay active, as well as fix a few minor bugs.

Multiplayer is still on track for the end of the month, will let you all know more nearer the time!

notes.title: Patch notes 0.7.0

MULTI-PLAYER SERVERS WILL BE OPENING AT THE END OF THE MONTH!!!

- During slow-mo you can now reload much faster

- The Spitter's acid attack now does damage to buildings/objects
- Gun turret health has been increased
- Fixed a bug where the spitter would sometimes hesitate to attack
- Fixed a bug where the grenade launcher would not shoot through fences

Multiplayer Progress Update:

We are working hard and making progress. We now have a fully working lobby system, where players can connect and chat to one and other. We are now working with gameplay itself, and in the near future will be opening up multiplayer lobbies for co-op gameplay! Stay tuned

- Richie O
